description: This file implements a singleton class 'ConnectorManager' that manages connectors and their work queue, handling asynchronous operations for connector actions such as create, update, and delete, specifically for shopping list entries and connector configurations within a Django project.

classes.name: ActionType
classes.description: Enum representing the type of action performed on a work item: created, updated, or deleted.

classes.name: Work
classes.description: Data class representing a unit of work with an instance and an action type.

classes.name: Singleton
classes.description: Metaclass implementing singleton pattern to ensure only one instance of classes using it.

classes.name: ConnectorManager
classes.description: Main class managing connector operations, including threading, queue management, and asynchronous connector calls.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ConnectorManager, setting up logger, queue, and worker thread.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Handles Django signals for create/update/delete actions, adding work to the queue.

methods.name: _add_work
methods.description: Adds work items to the queue for processing, filtering by class and presence of 'space'.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the queue and worker thread.

methods.name: is_initialized
methods.description: Checks if the singleton instance of ConnectorManager exists.

methods.name: add_work
methods.description: Manually injects work into the queue, if the manager is initialized.

methods.name: worker
methods.description: Worker thread function that processes work items asynchronously, managing connector cache and executing connector actions.

methods.name: get_connected_for_config
methods.description: Factory method to create connector instances based on config type.
